text: Timu ya taifa ya Tanzania imefuzu kucheza fainali za Kombe la Mataifa ya Afrika baada ya ushindi wa mabao matatu.
gloss: Tanzania's national team has qualified for the Africa Cup of Nations finals after a three-goal victory.

text: Babban bankin kasa ya sanar da sabon farashin ruwan riba domin shawo kan hauhawar farashin kayayyaki.
gloss: The central bank has announced a new interest rate to curb rising prices of goods.

text: Wizara ya afya imeanzisha kampeni ya chanjo dhidi ya ugonjwa wa surua kwa watoto chini ya miaka mitano.
gloss: The health ministry has launched a measles vaccination campaign for children under five.

text: Di new smartphone wey dem release get better camera and e fit last two days before you go charge am.
gloss: The newly released smartphone has a better camera and can last two days before charging.

text: Waumini maelfu walikusanyika kanisani kuadhimisha sikukuu ya Pasaka kwa nyimbo na sala.
gloss: Thousands of worshippers gathered at church to celebrate Easter with songs and prayers.

text: Jam'iyyun siyasa sun fara yakin neman zabe kafin zaben shugaban kasa da za a gudanar a shekara mai zuwa.
gloss: Political parties have begun campaigning ahead of the presidential election to be held next year.

text: Msanii maarufu ametoa albamu yake mpya na kutangaza ziara ya matamasha katika miji mikubwa ya Afrika Mashariki.
gloss: A famous artist has released a new album and announced a concert tour across major East African cities.

text: Government talk say dem go build new road wey go connect the two states before the end of the year.
gloss: The government says it will build a new road connecting the two states before the end of the year.

text: Kampuni ya teknolojia imezindua programu mpya inayotumia akili bandia kutafsiri lugha za Kiafrika.
gloss: A technology company has launched a new app that uses artificial intelligence to translate African languages.

text: Kungiyar kwallon kafa ta gida ta lashe gasar cin kofin kasa a wasan karshe da aka buga a filin wasa na Kaduna.
gloss: The local football club won the national cup in the final played at the Kaduna stadium.
